text: An Integrated scRNA-seq and Graph Neural Network Analysis
HCC is molecularly heterogeneous — bulk RNA-seq cannot resolve individual cell populations
Map the tumour microenvironment at single-cell resolution
Prioritise therapeutic targets from dysregulated hub genes
Rank approved drug candidates using graph neural networks
Bulk RNA-seq averages signals across all cell types, masking the tumour-immune interactions that drive HCC resistance. Single-cell resolution reveals which specific populations are responsible.
Tumour cells are more metabolically stressed and damaged during tissue dissociation → higher mitochondrial content → correctly excluded by the 5% filter.
Key insight: Macrophages dominate 4 of 14 clusters — tumour-associated macrophages (TAMs) are the central immunosuppressive force in this HCC microenvironment.
1,385  significant DEGs  ·   335 ↑   upregulated in tumour  ·   1,050 ↓   downregulated in tumour
Loss of ALB, APOA2, FABP1, and TF indicates loss of hepatocyte differentiation and function.
Upregulation of OLFM4 (and genes like CEACAM6/MIA) suggests a stem-like, more invasive tumor phenotype,
XIST reflects epigenetic dysregulation rather than directly indicating proliferation or invasion.
GSEA — all pathways downregulated in tumour
Negative NES (Normalized Enrichment Score) → pathway is downregulated in tumor
Loss of hepatocyte metabolic and synthetic functions
Suppression of lipid and cholesterol pathways

4 of 14 clusters are macrophages. Hub genes dominated by macrophage markers (CSF1R, TYROBP, AIF1, CD68). TAMs actively suppress the T-cell response that is simultaneously present but functionally impaired.
Extreme downregulation of ALB (−33.2 FC), APOA2, FABP1, AFP. PPAR & cholesterol pathways suppressed. Tumour cells abandon specialised liver functions for a proliferative, stem-like state.
Three independent iron chelators (Deferiprone, Deferasirox, Deferoxamine) all converge on FTL across both composite scoring and GNN ranking. Iron sequestration is a meaningful HCC dependency.

Sorafenib (rank 11) and Regorafenib (rank 2, 16) — the two FDA-approved HCC treatments — were recovered purely from data. This strongly validates the novel predictions: Minocycline (AIF1), IFN Gamma-1B (IFNGR2).
Next steps:  Experimental validation of Minocycline (AIF1) & Deferiprone (FTL) in HCC models · Spatial transcriptomics for co-localisation · Larger patient cohorts for stratification

A common framework for moving from raw omics data to interpretable biological results.
Reusable analysis logic  •  project-specific biological questions
HCC SINGLE-CELL TRANSCRIPTOMICS — WORKFLOW & ANALYTICAL STRATEGY
An end-to-end exploratory scRNA-seq workflow, from quality control to cell-type-specific biological interpretation.

CellTypist + ScType
SingleR + markers
11 broad labels

Pooled and cell-type-specific
DE + GSEA
interpretation
• Distribution-informed QC rather than copying the paper thresholds.
• Annotation supported by multiple references plus marker review.
• Cell-type-specific contrasts used to avoid over-interpreting pooled sample differences.

1 sample per analysis group.
Cells are observations within samples, not independent biological replicates.

Exploratory, sample-associated differences.
Good for workflow development and biological hypotheses, not population-level HCC conclusions.
I can build and critically audit a complete scRNA-seq workflow.
WHAT DID SINGLE-CELL RESOLUTION CHANGE BIOLOGICALLY?
The strongest finding is cellular composition; stratifying by cell type changes how expression differences are interpreted.
Fractions are among retained annotated cells — not direct tissue abundance.
HCC2 is T-cell dominated, whereas HCC1 contains many more macrophage- and hepatocyte-labelled cells.

T cells: ↑ chemokine / FoxO, ↓ oxidative phosphorylation
Fibroblasts: provisional contractile / actomyosin program
Interpretation is exploratory: one sample per group, composition confounding, and possible ambient RNA (e.g., widespread ALB signal).
Single-cell tells us what cells are doing; spatial analysis adds where those states occur and which cellular environments surround them.

Where are disease-associated hepatocyte states located?
Which immune populations form local neighborhoods around them?
Are inflammatory or fibrotic programs spatially restricted?
Do particular niches associate with disease severity?
Spatial analysis extends cell-state discovery into tissue architecture and local cellular interactions.
The biological question comes first — the method can range from established bioinformatics to custom statistical or AI solutions.

Biology → Omics → Statistics → AI

Different biological systems, transferable analytical reasoning.

Choose or develop the method that best answers the biological question.

Bioinformatics ↔ biology / clinical expertise ↔ wet lab

Computation prioritizes hypotheses; domain expertise guides interpretation; experiments validate them.
